create.name: Tara Stiles
create.bio:
Tara Stiles grew up in rural Illinois and trained as a dancer. She met hatha yoga as a teenager, when a teacher was brought into her ballet programme in Chicago, and after moving to New York to dance she began leading friends and fellow performers through simple practice backstage and between rehearsals. That informal teaching became Strala Yoga, the approach she co-founded with her husband, Mike Taylor, which began as a Manhattan studio and is now taught by trained guides in many countries.

Strala rests on the idea of moving with ease rather than force. Instead of holding fixed shapes, students are encouraged to follow the breath, keep the body soft and let each movement flow from the centre, with clear influences from tai chi and qigong. Her books include Strala Yoga, Guiding Strala for teachers, and Living Softly, due in March 2027, on getting more done with less tension. Her YouTube channel holds hundreds of short home practices, and she leads online home retreats and teacher trainings with Mike, in-person workshops in North America and Europe, and a weekend retreat at Kripalu. She also writes weekly essays on Substack and hosts the podcast Feel Better with Tara Stiles.

books.title: Living Softly
books.author: Tara Stiles
books.description: Tara Stiles's forthcoming book, due in March 2027, makes the case for dropping a push-through-it attitude in favour of softness. It offers practical ways to work, move and live with less strain while still getting things done.

books.title: Strala Yoga: Be Strong, Focused & Ridiculously Happy from the Inside Out
books.author: Tara Stiles
books.description: An introduction to the Strala approach, which favours easy, flowing movement and room to breathe over strict postures. Readers are shown how to adapt practice to their own bodies and carry the same ease into daily life.

books.title: Guiding Strala
books.author: Tara Stiles
books.description: A handbook for new and experienced yoga teachers who want to lead classes in the Strala way. It covers how to guide movement, sequence a class and help students find ease rather than strain.

courses.title: Living Softly: How to Accomplish More by Doing Less
courses.description: A weekend retreat at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, drawing on Tara's blend of yoga and tai chi. Lively morning sessions and gentler afternoon practice sit alongside workshops and reflection on using softness as a practical everyday skill.

courses.title: Rest and Renew You: Home Retreat with Tara
courses.description: A self-paced home retreat of 28 daily talks, meditations, practice sessions and simple recipes. It can be done in a single week or spread across ordinary days, as a way to slow down and reconnect.

courses.title: Simplify: Home Retreat with Tara
courses.description: Twenty-eight days of short talks, meditations and practice sessions on clearing clutter from the home, the diary and the mind. It also includes simple kitchen ideas and a personal money tracker.

courses.title: How to Practice at Home: Retreat with Tara
courses.description: A 32-part online retreat on building a home yoga practice that suits you, from setting up a space and planning sequences to getting past whatever stops you rolling out the mat.

courses.title: Strala Online 30+Hour Intensive Training: The Art of Sequencing
courses.description: An online intensive with Tara and Mike Taylor on how the order of movements shapes the feel of a class. Teachers and keen students learn to build sequences that energise, calm or comfort as needed.

courses.title: Strala Online 50+Hour Training, Tai Chi for Yoga Teachers
courses.description: A self-paced online training with Tara and Mike Taylor that brings tai chi principles into yoga teaching and personal practice. It includes recorded lessons and quarterly group calls on Zoom, and the material stays available after completion.

courses.title: Your Awesome Meditation Practice
courses.description: More than two hours of guided meditation with Tara, aimed at building a simple everyday habit of sitting and turning attention inward.

courses.title: Beginners' Series: Flexibility, Strength, Breath, Core, and Balance
courses.description: A structured on-demand series for people new to yoga, led by Tara. Separate sessions work through flexibility, strength, breath, core and balance, all at an easy pace.
